scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:client"
scripts.build: vue-tsc --noEmit && bun run build:client && bun run build:server
scripts.build:server: bun build server/index.ts --target=bun --outfile=dist-server/index.js --external bufferutil --external utf-8-validate --external pg-native --external cloudflare:sockets
scripts.preview: bun run build && bun run start
